name: CLS FX volume data (CLSMarketData)
rate_limits: Not applicable: a paid data product.
history_start: CLS says over 3 billion trades executed since 2011.
what_it_has: Settled FX volumes and flows from the CLS settlement system, sold as CLSMarketData. CLS also posts short monthly trading activity notes.
simple: The company that settles most big currency trades sells counts of how much was traded.
license_terms: No public licence or price list on the product page (checked 2026-10-21). Commercial licence by contract. Not usable for free.
quality_notes: Covers trades settled through CLS only.

relevance.reason: Best near real time volume measure, but paid.
